why: 4.0 ships without the debugger permission. These scenarios exercise what only the debugger can do (real key and pointer input, listener discovery, network-idle waits), so they cannot pass in the shipped build. They still run in the nightly debugger-on suite. Measured on 10 Nov 2026: results/e2e/e2e-debugger-off-2026-11-10.txt, 52 of 59 pass, these 7 fail.
